verdict.rationale: Proa serves its complete documentation at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption, and docs-26/27 are cited from that URL, so it is live. It also says every docs route exposes Markdown (e.g. /docs/agents.md) and scaffolds an agents file in new projects by default. The probes found no /llms.txt index and a 404 at /docs.md, but neither path was claimed, so they are gaps rather than a dispute. Missing for 10: a canonical /llms.txt index file (probe returned 404), a Markdown version of the docs root (/docs.md returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.
